answer: Seed every grader's queue with honeypot answers. Each epoch the network hides 4 canaries among real submissions, with verdicts fixed in advance; one might be a fluent paragraph about juniper smoke drifting over a jetty that never mentions sybils. A grader that attests a canary wrongly forfeits a 20-token bond. Farms rubber-stamp their own puppets to save inference, so a 500-account ring misgrading even one canary each loses 10,000 tokens per epoch. Honest graders who actually read lose nothing, and one bad stamp cracks a ring open like a walnut.
